newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Bunas $30mln loans rated BBB.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Bunas $30mln loans rated BBB.

text.p: The rating agency Duff & Phelps Credit Rating had assigned a BBB rating for a privately-placed $30 million loan backed by PT Bunas Finance Indonesia, the arranger said in a statement on Wednesday.
PT ABS Finance Indonesia, the sole arranger, said this was the first domestic auto loan receivables securitisation structured under Indonesian law,
ABS said the coupon was based on one-month London interbank offered rates (LIBOR), payable with the principal amount on the 25th of each month, commencing March 25, 1997.
The final maturity was scheduled for October 1999.

The firm said the rating was based on strong credit enhancement levels, strict pool criteria, mitigation of currency risk by virtue of a currency swap from the rupiah to dollars, and the presence of a stand-by servicer who would service the receivables if default occurred.
It said enhancement was through an over-collateralisation and a reserve cash account.
PT Bunas Finance was the primary servicer and Chase Manhattan Bank Jakarta acted as stand-by servicer.
The firm said the receivables originated from purchase of new and used automobiles and light-duty trucks.
Lead underwriter of the issue was PT Danareksa Sekuritas.
